newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Foods names Benjamin president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Foods names Benjamin president, CEO.

text.p: Specialty Foods Corp said Wednesday it named Lawrence Benjamin as president and chief executive officer of both Specialty Foods and its parent, Specialty Foods Acquisition Corp, effective immediately.
Benjamin replaces Paul Liska, who resigned to pursue other business interests, the company said. Specialty Foods said Benjamin would be elected to the board of directors of both companies.
Since 1994, Benjamin has been president and chief executive officer of Stella Foods, Specialty Foods' largest unit. He will continue as chief executive of Stella "for the foreseeable future".
Specialty Foods Corp is a group of diversified food companies with $2 billion in annual sales in specialty cheese, wholesale baking, cookies and snacks, and prepared meats.
